base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name, ', ')
FROM (
  SELECT T1."XCL_035" || ' ' || T1."XCL_036" AS name
  FROM member AS T1
  INNER JOIN attendance AS A ON T1."XCL_034" = A."XCL_002"
  INNER JOIN event AS E ON A."XCL_001" = E."XCL_010"
  INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
  WHERE E."XCL_011" = 'November Speaker'
  GROUP BY T1."XCL_034", T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
  ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_020") DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
